vectors.title: Native permissions, browser restart, allowances and denial through shutdown
vectors.applicability: Required for the declared native Chromium extension CWI profile. Other wallets, platforms and communications substrates require separate admission.
preconditions: Digest-verified Yours PR368 exact expanded-profile engineering candidate and compiled ToDo artifacts
Supported mainnet configuration with pinned Go services, isolated fixture identity, and mined fixture funding
The prospective plan infra/native/conformance/plan-pr368-coverage-5.json and independent predicates are fixed before execution
steps: With legacy automatic prompt decisions suspended, submit the same Level 2 protocol/key/counterparty request at two fresh controlled application origins through public window.CWI.
Require an explicit no-consent rejection, then approve the pending primary-origin request through the matching native Protocol Permission UI and verify cached access.
Prove the primary grant does not authorize the alternate origin; deny its matching pending prompt, verify denial creates no grant, and verify the primary grant survives.
Approve the alternate origin explicitly, verify both authorized derivations agree, and close all scenario-owned pages and prompts.
Run separately declared basket, certificate and one-shot spending approval/denial scenarios through public CWI and visible category-specific native prompts.
Revoke individual and origin-wide grants through Settings Permissions; prove loss of access, preservation of unrelated scope, and subsequent explicitly approved recovery.
Passively retain the exact trusted native click event before the wallet popup may close, and independently join the original terminal public CWI result to the same pending-call nonce.
After the last scenario, close the native browser and all owned controlled services, then capture every provider ledger with the original global prefix and provider-local suffix provenance.
Exercise protocol, basket, certificate and both linkage grant caches and origin isolation with distinct frozen contexts.

Close the native browser completely, reopen the same isolated profile, unlock through supported UI and repeat cached operations; revoke origin grants through Settings and prove revocation survives another full restart.

Serve a controlled application manifest and explicitly select the native spending checkbox; exercise two cumulative under-cap payments, cumulative overflow denial, alternate-origin denial and revocation.
Independently verify selected-field and linkage cryptography, trusted checkbox/click receipts, context identity continuity and every denied payment through all final provider ledger suffixes.
Prospective completion modules: permissions (8 scoped predicates). Exact IDs are frozen in the4.5 profile; all parent bindings remain mandatory.
expected: All eight frozen permissions assertions pass using the exact nine-call sequence and actual Allow/Deny decisions. The matching UI identifies origin, protocol, security level, and counterparty while the request is pending.

The exact same requested capability requires consent independently at each origin. Rejection after Deny preserves the primary grant and leaves the alternate origin unauthorized until explicit approval.
Timeouts, detached pages, network failures, unsupported methods, and observer errors do not qualify as permission denial. Three screenshot hashes bind the captured UI evidence.

All new category and revocation predicates must pass alongside the original eight protocol predicates. Generic errors, missing prompts and timeouts cannot establish permission denial; wallet state and cryptographic effects are independently verified.

A target-closed automation response may accompany a passing decision only when an actual trusted click and the matching terminal native result are retained. Missing events, stale request nonces, generic errors and timeouts never substitute for a wallet decision.

The complete post-shutdown provider inventory and submission ledger bind the immutable scenario/global reports and worker receipt. No matching denied or unapproved customer payment occurs through final closure; only the independently verified explicitly approved payment is eligible for its declared exception.
All29 additional permission-coverage outcomes are retained even when the wallet fails a case. Screenshots alone cannot establish checkbox selection, consent or a cached grant.

The new permission coverage report is hash-bound in shutdown policy2 alongside the unchanged earlier lifecycle report; four distinct denied payment amounts remain absent from every final provider ledger.

Prospective exact PR368 candidate e360e67 engineering profile with 698 native predicates: 535 retained predecessor identities plus 8 permission-sequence, 39 basket-boundary, 25 pagination, 20 certificate-rejection, 8 transaction-branch and 63 scoped existing-trace predicates. These scoped predicates preserve remaining whole-row obligations and interpretation blockers. Nine actual browser contexts in one isolated profile, exact source-owned provider inventories, authenticated action-RPC journals, mined funding and final submission ancestry are mandatory. The action observer does not establish a native CWI-to-RPC join or normative whole-action membership. Permission oracle 5 retains the 100-satoshi fee-inclusive cap on fresh managed funding before customer tasks. The exact tenth Go layer includes caller-declared known-input handling, all supplied BUMP-root verification and bounded same-host inventories atop the immutable nine-layer chain. Source/count bindings are frozen; native admission remains separate; no official-release qualification or complete BRC100 claim.
blockers: Missing native UI, incomplete observations, or required control failures are retained as non-passing findings; no alternate transport or simulated permission result substitutes for them.

vectors.title: Native transaction rejection, exact-state preservation, and recovery
vectors.applicability: Required for the declared native Chromium extension CWI profile. Other wallets, platforms and communications substrates require separate admission.
preconditions: Digest-verified Yours PR368 exact expanded-profile engineering candidate and compiled ToDo artifacts
Supported mainnet configuration with pinned Go services, isolated fixture identity, and mined fixture funding
The prospective plan infra/native/conformance/plan-pr368-coverage-5.json and independent predicates are fixed before execution
steps: Retain the original ToDo UI acceptance, rejection, and recovery sequence and all of its independent predicates.
Through the same native wallet public CWI, create separate accepted, rejected, and recovered actions under a fixed service verdict schedule, with immediate broadcast requested.

Capture controlled service submissions independently of wallet results; compare full action and output projections, exact metadata, raw transaction bytes, and proof-carrying ancestry after every verdict.
expected: The original ToDo UI predicates and all three prospective API predicates pass together. Success in one path never hides failure in the other.

Acceptance corresponds to the exact independently observed service submission and serialized output. Rejection produces the specified terminal failed/invalidTx result, no tracked rejected action, and an identical prior spendable-output projection.

Controlled service acceptance, wallet-state findings, and public-mainnet acceptance remain distinct.
blockers: A valid non-passing wallet finding remains FAIL; missing required UI or proof evidence cannot be replaced by a reference wallet result.

vectors.title: Data portability and counterpart replacement
vectors.applicability: Required for the declared native Chromium extension CWI profile. Other wallets, platforms and communications substrates require separate admission.
preconditions: Digest-verified Yours PR368 exact expanded-profile engineering candidate and compiled ToDo artifacts
Supported mainnet configuration with pinned Go services, isolated fixture identity, and mined fixture funding
The prospective plan infra/native/conformance/plan-pr368-coverage-5.json and independent predicates are fixed before execution
steps: Create an encrypted task through ordinary ToDo UI and record its public-wallet outpoint, decrypted content, transaction bytes and metadata.
Add, synchronize, activate, and remove storage counterparts through the unchanged native wallet settings UI. Authenticated read-only observers compare the complete canonical logical datasets.
Stop the source storage TCP listener and prove it is unavailable, then Lock/Unlock the native wallet, clear the application cache, and reload ToDo.

Recover the same identity, task, ciphertext and unspent outpoint from the replacement, redeem the task through ToDo UI, verify the signed spend and persisted replacement state, and restore the source endpoint.

Use portability oracle3 to retain every bounded complete-dataset poll until signed redemption, then final task read and complete snapshot; require successful replacement processAction before restoring the source.
expected: All nine portability assertions pass in native-ui mode with two distinct storage identities and separate databases. Reference-engineering runs are retained separately and cannot qualify this vector.
The native wallet mediates authenticated synchronization; the observer does not populate the replacement. Complete logical records, bytes, metadata, and foreign-key relationships match.
The original source remains unreachable during cold reconstruction and redemption. The live native wallet context and application cache are discarded before proving replacement recovery.
The same encrypted task is visible and decryptable, and its valid signed redemption is persisted on the replacement while the source is unavailable. Cleanup restores the stopped endpoint.

A reserved input or unsigned transaction cannot establish redemption. The signed spend, proof closure, successful replacement RPC and final public state all precede source restoration. Rendered active-status comparison permits exact-line case and whitespace normalization only.
blockers: Unsupported native settings operations, incomplete dataset projection, unproven source outage, or a missing native-mediated write prevent qualification.
